components.name: DisplayFrame
components.description:
The shared chrome for the Display pieces: a header with an icon, a title, a line of meta and a row of actions, over a body that holds the content.

<DisplayFrame icon={<FileTextIcon />} title="report.pdf" meta="PDF"
  actions={<DisplayOpenAction href={url} />}>
  … </DisplayFrame>

props.name: meta
props.description: A short line beside the title: a format, a size, dimensions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons at the end of the header.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: A second row under the header, for view switches and zoom.

props.name: bare
props.description: Drop the border and header; the body alone.

components.name: DisplayAction
components.description: An icon button for a display header.

components.name: DisplayDownloadAction
components.description: Downloads `href`, saved as `filename` when the browser allows it.

components.name: DisplayCopyAction
components.description: Copies `text` (or what it returns) to the clipboard.

components.name: DisplaySwitch
components.description: A two-or-more way switch for a display toolbar, e.g. Preview / Code.

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { value: T; label: string; disabled?: boolean; }[]
